The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `8443` (see `LowkeyVaultBuilder.LowkeyVaultPort`)
- Port: `8080` (see `LowkeyVaultBuilder.LowkeyVaultTokenPort`)
- Environment variable: `LOWKEY_ARGS=--LOWKEY_VAULT_RELAXED_PORTS=true`
- Wait strategy: Waits until a message matching `(?s).*Started LowkeyVaultApp.*$` is logged.
